automated_findings.description: ARIA attribute value invalid. TabsTrigger for 'play' has aria-controls pointing to a Radix-generated panel ID (e.g. radix-:r0:-content-play) that does not exist in the DOM. Root cause: the explicit id='panel-play' passed to TabsContent overrides Radix's internally generated DOM id, but Radix's aria-controls wiring on the trigger still references the original generated id — creating a dangling aria-controls reference. Symmetrically, the panel's aria-labelledby references a Radix-generated trigger id that was overridden by the explicit id='tab-play' on TabsTrigger.
automated_findings.suggested_fix: Remove explicit id props from all TabsTrigger and TabsContent elements. Let Radix manage ARIA IDs and their cross-references internally. Update e2e selectors from page.locator('#panel-library') to role-based queries (getByRole('tabpanel', { name: '...' })) or add data-testid attributes instead. See: https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/aria-valid-attr-value?application=axeAPI

automated_findings.description: The <footer role='contentinfo'> is nested inside <main> (implicit role='main'). The contentinfo landmark must be a direct descendant of the page root, not nested inside another landmark. This violates ARIA landmark best practices (not a strict WCAG 2.2 AA criterion but an axe best-practice rule).
automated_findings.suggested_fix: Move the <footer role='contentinfo' ...> outside of <main className='sb-app'> so it is a top-level landmark. Alternatively, if the footer is intentionally scoped to the main content, remove role='contentinfo' (a plain <footer> inside <main> is valid HTML without the explicit role). See: https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/landmark-contentinfo-is-top-level?application=axeAPI

manual_checks.item: Verify semantic structure end-to-end: h1 in header, tablist/tab/tabpanel roles from Radix, main landmark, footer landmark placement.
Verify color is not the only means of conveying information (e.g. active tab state uses visual indicator beyond color alone).
Verify all functionality is operable via keyboard only (tab into tablist, navigate triggers, open panels, interact with panel content).
Verify focus order is logical and predictable: header → tablist → active panel content → footer.
Verify content reflows without loss at 320px width (Tailwind responsive layout, TabsList w-full, no horizontal scroll).

TSK-143 specific — Radix keyboard delegation: Tab key reaches the tablist; within the tablist ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (and ArrowUp/ArrowDown for vertical) navigate between triggers; Home moves to first trigger; End moves to last trigger. Verify these work after the aria-controls id fix.

TSK-143 specific — After id conflict fix: verify aria-controls on each TabsTrigger correctly points to its TabsContent panel, and aria-labelledby on each panel correctly points back to its trigger. All 4 tab/panel pairs must be wired.

TSK-143 specific — Panel Play forceMount + data-[state=inactive]:hidden: verify that when Play is not the active tab, the panel is not perceivable by assistive technologies. Radix sets the HTML hidden attribute on inactive TabsContent (removing from a11y tree); the Tailwind data-[state=inactive]:hidden rule is a defensive CSS-only layer. Both mechanisms must coexist without exposing hidden content.

TSK-143 specific — Color contrast of TabsTrigger active/inactive states in light and dark themes: active state uses data-[state=active]:bg-background + data-[state=active]:text-foreground; inactive uses text-muted-foreground on bg-muted. Verify contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for normal text in both themes.

positive_findings: Radix Tabs manages role='tablist', role='tab', role='tabpanel' and aria-selected natively — no manual ARIA role maintenance required after migration.
TabsList has aria-label='Sezioni app' — provides accessible name for the tablist landmark; compatible with e2e selectors getByRole('tablist', { name: 'Sezioni app' }).
TabsTrigger has focus-visible ring styles (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2) — WCAG 2.4.7 / 2.4.11 focus visibility satisfied.
<h1> in header wraps logo img with alt='Soli-boy' — WCAG 1.1.1 (non-text content) and page-has-heading-one landmark both satisfied.

ConfirmGameChangeDialog implements role='dialog' + aria-modal='true' + aria-labelledby + aria-describedby + Esc handler + focus trap (Tab/Shift+Tab bounded to two buttons) — robust WAI-ARIA modal implementation.
Color contrast overrides in app-extra.css (TSK-084) pre-empt known insufficient-contrast findings for dark, 90s-party and cyberpunk themes on chip-on and danger button states.
Keyboard navigation (Arrow/Home/End/Space/Enter) is delegated to Radix — eliminates drift risk vs WAI-ARIA APG tab pattern that affected the previous manual onKeyDown handler.

forceMount on panel Play combined with Radix-managed hidden attribute: Player component stays mounted across tab switches (preserving WasmBoy state) without exposing a11y items — hidden attribute removes panel from accessibility tree when inactive.
